profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer @Staples | React, Java, and Python

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer ll
positions.description:
• Built and maintained scalable SEO backend services for Staples.com while driving front-end improvements to
enhance search engine compliance across high-traffic e-commerce pages.
• Refactored reactive stream architecture to achieve a 40% reduction in P99 latency, significantly enhancing backend service performance.
• Increased exposed page coverage by 6% through targeted SEO and indexation improvements.
• Architected a semantic related search widget for Staples Business Advantage, improving internal page linking and enhancing product discoverability for customers.
• Member of the Hackathon Planning Committee, organizing internal hackathons to drive R&D and foster innovation across teams

projects.title: Data Science Capstone
projects.description:
Equity Portfolio Construction, Optimization, and Performance Analysis using Machine Learning

The goal of this project is to use sentiment and technical data to predict the outcome of the top 50 stocks by volume in the S&P 500 index. Data collected was between the period of 2016-2021. The semantic data consisted of 500,000 tweets which we ran an analysis on to determine whether it was positive, neutral, or negative. This data was inputted into Long Short Term and Gated Recurrent Unit models and tuned. These models were then trained and evaluated. 

The full project can be found here: https://github.com/will10221/Data-Science-Capstone
